maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from payment processing fees and software subscriptions (Seed, card readers) on self-service machines, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private vending and unattended-retail operators; consumers' cashless payments fund revenue, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling payments, software and hardware to operators; past deals (365 Retail Markets, Yoyo) are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded payment readers and vending management software run operators' machines; switching means replacing hardware and migrating operations.

notes: Cantaloupe was reportedly being acquired by 365 Retail Markets (2025); answers reflect its business as described.
